raw_text: My name is William. I was born in Texas in Houston, although we moved to Austin before I can remember anything. I grew up on the south side of town, a block away from my elementry school, William's Elementary. Yes really. Growing up I was fond of D&D, which evolved into a love for playing games on computers that were similar in genre. That, in turn, gave birth to my plan to be a designer. About the time I would have started that career the personal computer had become all but common place and I found the internet a year or two before it started to become more common. Having started with computers and the internet early on grew to a career where I've always had an advantaged because I was born with the right neurodivergence at the right time
